# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `spacefast` MCP server pointing at Spacefast's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.spacefast.com`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration — no API key to configure.
- Logo: the `spacefast` GitHub organization avatar.
